name: Decking
description: Wood or composite deck surface with joists, screws, hangers and rim; ledger with fasteners and flashing; beams; footings with posts; guards with balusters; stairs by riser. Spans and sizes come from the IRC deck section or DCA 6. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: International Residential Code, Section R507 Exterior Decks
DCA 6, Prescriptive Residential Wood Deck Construction Guide
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)
International Residential Code, Section R312 Guards and Window Fall Protection

assume: Boards 5-1/2 in wide with 1/8 in gaps: 2.133 LF per SF, 10% waste.
Joists at 16 in o.c. (span them from IRC Table R507.6): 0.75 LF per SF, 10% waste.
Two screws per board at each joist: 3.2 per SF (hidden fasteners per their maker).
Joist hangers: two per joist, counted from the joist length at 12 ft average: hangers = joist LF / 12 x 2.
Rim joists on the outline P (doubled where the drawings say).
items.note: Measure the deck area on the plan.
